warnings.message: Renovate: packageRules[0] in renovate.json (line 5) sets minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" for updates of Cargo packages, shorter than the 3 days depcurfew apply writes for Renovate; Renovate uses the rule, and depcurfew apply does not change entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
